correctness.rationale: For identical common binary valuations, EF1_outer follows if values differ by at most 1 and high-value bundles contain a removable valued vertex. When k<=b, cycling all valued vertices and placing zero connectors on each missing side yields connected balanced bundles, with extra zeros deposited in a low bundle. When k>=a, p=a+b-k cross edges plus singletons can be matched so that all bundles carry values 0/1 or 1/2; the bipartite zero–one/zero–zero matching argument covers both W<=k and W>k. When b<k<a the all-one profile forces a singleton and a >=3-vertex bundle, contradiction. Independent exact brute profiles for a<=5 confirmed all claimed positive cases and each all-one negative case; not infinite proof.
